# DSH Isolated Runtime

Kubernetes resource lifecycle and workload image for self-hosted, multi-user DeepSeek Harness. Install through dsh-multi-tenant.

- [Runtime contract](https://github.com/GuoMonth/dsh-isolated-runtime/blob/main/docs/en/contract.md)
- [Platform installation](https://github.com/GuoMonth/dsh-multi-tenant)
